items.title: Hoxton Wealth appoints Tom Claridge as inaugural chief investment officer
items.summary: Hoxton Wealth has named Tom Claridge as its first chief investment officer following growth to $5bn in assets under management.

items.title: Optalitix adds agentic AI to quote platform for underwriting automation
items.summary: Insurtech firm Optalitix has integrated agentic AI into its quote platform to automate complex underwriting tasks while maintaining human decision-making control.

items.title: Markel International outlines clinical trial insurance placement factors
items.summary: Markel International senior life science underwriter Rob Hannaford highlights the licensing and country-specific rules that dictate clinical trial insurance timelines.

items.title: M&G Catalyst raises $900m growth equity fund with UK allocation target
items.summary: M&G Investments has closed its M&G Catalyst Growth Equity Fund at $900m, with plans to commit approximately 20% of its capital to British companies.

items.title: Cedar Trace secures Lloyd’s underwriting permission for Syndicate 1503
items.summary: Cedar Trace Underwriting has gained official permission from Lloyd’s to write business for the 2027 Year of Account through its new $300 million syndicate.
